name: Potion of Climbing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: For 1 hour: a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and Advantage on Athletics checks to climb.
text: When you drink this potion, you gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour. During that time, you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks you make to climb. The potion is separated into brown, silver and gray layers like bands of stone; shaking it doesn't mix them.
